title: Add owner login with Principal ID and serial number management

requirements.text: Implement owner/admin login system that provides access control for entry management operations including adding new entries, correcting existing entries, and modifying entry data

quotes: login for website or app owner provide access for entry, entry correction or modification

acceptanceCriteria: Owner can log in using Internet Identity authentication
Authenticated owner has permissions to add new entries
Authenticated owner can correct/edit existing entries
Authenticated owner can modify entry data
Unauthenticated users cannot access entry management features

requirements.text: When a Principal ID is modified for any entry, automatically update the associated Serial Number to reflect the change and maintain data consistency

quotes: principle ID modified than principle ID change for Serial Number

acceptanceCriteria: When a Principal ID is updated, the system automatically generates or updates the corresponding Serial Number
Serial Number changes are persisted to backend storage
Serial Number update happens atomically with Principal ID modification
Updated Serial Number is immediately reflected in the UI

requirements.text: Display updated Serial Numbers in the staff management interface whenever Principal IDs are modified, ensuring users can verify the automatic serial number assignment

quotes: principle ID modified than principle ID change for Serial Number

acceptanceCriteria: Serial Number field shows the current value for each staff entry
When Principal ID is modified, Serial Number updates are visible immediately
Serial Number display is read-only and auto-generated

constraints: Use existing Internet Identity authentication system
Do not modify immutable frontend paths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui)
nonGoals: Creating a separate admin portal or login page
Implementing custom authentication beyond Internet Identity
Manual serial number entry or override functionality
